jobs.prompt: Update the best open source models ranking page. Read content/media/best-open-source-models.html. Use web_search to find the latest rankings from LMSYS Chatbot Arena, Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard, and Papers with Code. Update the ranking table with current top 10 models, their scores, providers, categories, and update dates. Update the last updated date and sources. Keep the same HTML structure and styling. After updating, run npm run build, git add content/media/best-open-source-models.html, git commit with message 'chore: update open source models ranking [date]', git push, then deployStatic to both preview and prod.

Update the Games Tracker page at content/media/2026-04-28-upcoming-games-2026.html with the latest information for ALL video games included in the page that are NOT released. For each unreleased game: 1) Run web searches to check current release status, date, and any new announcements. 2) Update the release badges - if a game has been released, change its release badge to use class 'release-badge release-released' with text 'RELEASED'. 3) Update any release dates, descriptions, or metadata that have changed. 4) Update the 'Last updated' date at the top of the page. 5) Add any new sources with current access dates. Then rebuild the site with npm run build, git add content/media/2026-04-28-upcoming-games-2026.html, git commit with message 'chore: update games tracker [date]', git push, then deployStatic to prod.
